description: This file defines a class for simple email validation using a regular expression, inheriting from a potentially more comprehensive email URI validation class. It provides a method to validate email addresses with a basic pattern check.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_Email_SimpleCheck
classes.description: A class providing simple email address validation based on a specific regular expression pattern.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input string as an email address using a regex pattern. Returns the email if valid, otherwise false.
